name: @patdown/oxlint-config
description: Shared Oxlint configuration presets for patdown

scripts.check: node ../../scripts/warn-direct-package-task.mjs check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.lint: node ../../scripts/warn-direct-package-task.mjs lint && oxlint . && pnpm run lint:anti-slop
scripts.test: node ../../scripts/warn-direct-package-task.mjs test && node --test artifact-entrypoint-lint.test.ts json-decode.test.ts manifest-lint.test.ts no-phantom-never-mapped-type-lint.test.ts no-record-string-unknown-lint.test.ts no-unconstrained-input-generic-lint.test.ts source-resolution-lint.test.ts tsconfig-split-lint.test.ts vitest-resolution-lint.test.ts workspace-verification-lint.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: node ../../scripts/warn-direct-package-task.mjs typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile typecheck.tsbuildinfo && tsc -p tsconfig.anti-slop.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile typecheck.anti-slop.tsbuildinfo
